name: SDAT
subtitle: Personal iPhone TIDAL player
description: Unsigned builds of SDAT, a SwiftUI TIDAL player for iOS 26 with Liquid Glass, powered by the tonearm-rs Rust core. Built by GitHub Actions from https://github.com/Nichokas/SDAT.

apps.name: SDAT
apps.subtitle: TIDAL player with Liquid Glass
apps.localizedDescription: Personal iPhone TIDAL player in SwiftUI with Liquid Glass, powered by the tonearm-rs Rust core.

versions.localizedDescription:
Changes since 1.0.0:
- Renamed to SDAT (new bundle id `com.nichokas.SDAT`, so it installs as a separate app from Torneam)
- Redesigned login and a boot loader that shows real warm-up progress
- Offline downloads: Downloads screen, download status ring, download option in "…" menus
- Highest-quality downloads and an offline playback indicator
- Offline album pages and local-first covers
- Background downloads with system progress (BGContinuedProcessingTask); interrupted queues resume on next launch
- Discover: long-press context menu on cover tiles
- Faster collapse/expand animations; miniplayer hold threshold 0.12 s
- New transparent reel app icon

Unsigned build: sideload with your own signing tool.

First release.
- TIDAL playback via the tonearm-rs Rust core
- Liquid Glass UI with morphing tab bar and circular miniplayer
- Discover with infinite queue
- Queue editing, repeat and shuffle
- Lock screen controls with favorite
- Playback resume after relaunch
- Call/interruption handling
